items.headline: $HYPE Lending Launch Sees $269M Borrowed Day One
items.summary: Hyperliquid's new manual borrowing and lending feature pulled in $269M in loans within 24 hours, a massive DeFi debut for $HYPE.

items.headline: $POL Set for 100M Token Permissionless Burn
items.summary: Polygon is preparing a community-callable burn of 100 million $POL, with contracts on testnet awaiting final Security Council signatures.

items.headline: $NEAR Surges 32% as Tokenization Tokens Lead Rally
items.summary: $NEAR jumped 32% with $STRK up 27% and $ARB up 26%, as tokenization-themed alts led a broad market rally.

items.headline: $ZEC Whale Moves $360M, First Exchange Deposit in 10 Months
items.summary: A $ZEC whale shifted $362.56M and deposited $15M to Coinbase — its first exchange move in ten months, sparking sell-off speculation.

items.headline: $NUSD Depegs to 51 Cents, Junior Tranche Faces Wipeout
items.summary: Neutrl opened $NUSD redemptions at just $0.51 while Strata's junior tranche jrNUSD faces being written to zero — a fresh DeFi blowup.
